name: BEACON
full_name: Beamforming Elevated Array for COsmic Neutrinos
summary: A mountaintop radio-neutrino concept with an implemented prototype uses elevation and interferometric triggering to survey large areas for tau-neutrino air showers.
detection_principle: Antennas view the horizon for geomagnetic radio pulses from upward showers produced after Earth-skimming tau neutrinos interact in rock. Coherent beamforming reduces the detection threshold.

sites.name: BEACON prototype
sites.location: Barcroft Field Station, White Mountains, California

status.label: Research and development
status.evidence: A working prototype and active design studies are documented; the large proposed station network is not treated as completed.

timeline.event: Updated diffuse and transient sensitivity study released.

key_parameters.value: Distributed elevated stations remain a proposed scale-up

results.summary: Demonstrated radio-background characterisation and interferometric triggering; calculated full-array neutrino sensitivities remain projections.

science_scope: Parameters refer to the named apparatus or explicitly identified design phase. Projections describe sensitivity goals and are not observations.
